integrity: The coordinate matrix is checked directly to have orthonormal columns and to satisfy the adjacency eigenvalue equation. The graph spectrum, facet supports, vertex shells, minimum-enclosing sphere, inball, uniqueness statements, and edge length are then derived exactly. The packaged checker replays all finite linear-algebra and polyhedral identities.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the orthonormally normalized second eigenpolytope of the rhombic-dodecahedron graph, not arbitrary affine realizations. It does not resolve the classification of non-vertex-transitive spectral polytopes. An older Licata--Powers report establishing spectral reproduction was only partially inspectable and remains the main originality risk.
title: The exceptional spectral rhombic dodecahedron is tangential but has two exact vertex shells
